_comment: The item catalogue. Prices are in marks -- the coin the game calls gold in code and Port Azure calls marks out loud. An item with a `use` block can be used from the inventory; `effect` names an entry in data/items/status_effects.json.

beer_bottle.description: Brown glass, no label. Mira brews it in the cellar and denies it.

use.text: You drink the ale. It is warm, and it is not good, and it helps.
